sentences.en: No other sport in Brazil is so popular as soccer.
sentences.zh: 在巴西，没有其他运动像足球那样受欢迎。

sentences.en: The writer is very popular because he expresses himself well.
sentences.zh: 这位作家很受欢迎，因为他表达得很好。

sentences.en: Organic vegetables are popular because they're safe and tasty.
sentences.zh: 有机蔬菜很受欢迎，因为它们既安全又好吃。

senses.zh: 受欢迎的，流行的；广受喜爱的；通俗的，大众的
